spec_gaps.description: feat-prove-pool-lifecycle's behavior sentence and INV-POOL-2's own text describe the over-cap trigger as 'a request beyond the cap' -- i.e. eviction fires synchronously when the (cap+1)th distinct project is requested, independent of A-001's separately-described 15-minute idle timer. Not treated as an ambiguity requiring a spec_gap: the feature's own context note explicitly instructs using a small cap fixture 'instead of waiting on the 15-minute idle window', confirming the two are distinct triggers and this plan's scope (INV-POOL-2, INV-POOL-4) covers only the cap-exceeded trigger, not a time-based idle-eviction invariant (no INV- id names that separate mechanism, and it is not cited by this feature's falsifier).
